parameters.title: Select spectral bands per indicator by permutation importance, RFE or tree-based importance
parameters.label: Select the spectral bands that matter for an indicator, ranked by permutation importance (out-of-fold on the training samples), recursive feature elimination (RFE/RFECV, regressors with coefficients or feature importances) or tree-based (extra trees) importance. Needs a dataframe with spectra and indicators, e.g. a compiled dataset; covariates are not selected, and only used as indicators when named in indicator_array. The selection is made on the training samples (the holdout of regression_modeling) and replayed as fixed bands by regression_modeling.

parameter.hint: The root fp of the project
The dataframe to use as input, raw = original spectra, previous = the latest saved parquet file(s), or state the name of the parquet file with spectra derived from earlier step(s) to use as input.
Indicators to select bands for; empty = every numeric indicator of the dataframe except the covariates of a compiled dataset (a covariate named here is processed).
Selectors to run: permutation, rfe, tree_based. rfe falls back to permutation for regressors without coefficients or feature importances (knn, mlp, svr rbf).
Regressors used by permutation and rfe (ols, theil_sen, huber, knn, dectree, randfor, svr, mlp, cubist, plsr); one selection per regressor. Not used by tree_based.

Selector settings: default, none, a selector parameter set name or a JSON path relative to the project root. Keys: permutation {permutation_repeats, folds (default 5)}, rfe {CV (0 = RFE, >0 = RFECV with that many folds, picks the number of bands), step (>= 1 bands, < 1 fraction removed per round)}, tree_based {n_estimators}.
If the selection should be done sepately for each indicator, false = all indicators in one selection (single dataframe output); true= individual dataframes will be created for each indicator.
Regressor hyper-parameters: default, none, a parameter set name or a JSON path relative to the project root.
Maximum number of features to show in the selector bar plot. 0 = show all. Y-axis labels are suppressed when showing more than 40 features.
Number of top-ranked bands to retain and save. 0 = the number RFECV chose (rfe with CV > 0), else asked after the plot (0 typed = not saved).

Fraction of the samples held out as test samples (hash of the sample id, the same holdout as regression_modeling). The bands are selected from the remaining training samples only. Must equal test_size of regression_modeling, otherwise the selection is flagged as made with test samples included. 0 = use all samples.
Colour ramp for plotting spectra: a matplotlib colormap name, or default = the spectra_plot parameter set (ml_setting, "jet").
Save the selection plot(s) (plot/selection_plot for permutation/RFE/tree, plus the band scores under band_selection/; plot/ for univariate).
Optional user extension (1-6 letters, digits or -) added to the file suffix after a hashtag, e.g. .c-org-plsr-pms#k20, to tell apart outputs with different settings.
